name: Password
effect: A wall. Blocks descent until de-rezzed or bypassed with stealth.
flavor: A shimmering lattice of permission you do not have.

name: Hound
effect: Raises the alarm if not destroyed before it acts; accelerates the security clock.
flavor: It smells you the moment you jack in.

name: Bloodhound
effect: Relentless tracker; high perception and alarm, pins your location.
flavor: Once it has your scent, the whole tower knows where you stand.

name: Rust
effect: Damage-over-time to the netrunner's deck HP each round it survives.
flavor: Your icebreakers come back slick and corroded.

name: Hellbolt
effect: Heavy single-target burst against the netrunner.
flavor: A column of white fire down the data spine.

name: Killer
effect: Lethal. If the netrunner flatlines to Killer, the meatspace body dies.
flavor: It does not want your data. It wants your brain.

name: Warden
effect: Persistent, high-durability; hard to remove, raises alarm while alive.

name: Wall
effect: A heavy barrier. High DEF; soaks attacks and stalls the clock.
flavor: Brick by brick, in a language made of locks.

name: Wisp
effect: Fragile but sharp-eyed; very hard to stealth past, raises alarm fast.
flavor: A floating eye that blinks the alarm awake.

name: Asp
effect: Corrodes programs; degrades the deck the longer the fight runs.
flavor: A thin green line that keeps biting.

name: Scorpion
effect: Aggressive daemon; hits hard and pings security each round it lives.
flavor: It does not chase. It waits where you must pass.

name: Hellhound
effect: Lethal black ICE that also raises the alarm; flatline = meat death.
flavor: It runs you down and lights you up at once.

name: Kraken
effect: Massive, slow, near-unkillable black ICE guarding deep vaults.
flavor: Something vast turns over in the dark of the system.

name: Dragon
effect: Boss-tier black ICE. The thing at the bottom of The Last Job.
flavor: The oldest predator in the NET, and it knows your name.
